news.title: FGLI Services makes the invisible, visible — and accessible — for first generation and limited income students
news.summary_en: The new office aims to connect UW–Madison students with mentorship opportunities, important resources and each other.

news.title: Badger basketball legend Frank Kaminsky will address graduates at winter commencement
news.summary_en: The former college player of the year will return to the Kohl Center, on the very court he dominated, to deliver the keynote on Dec. 13.
